site_surface.short_summary: Abzan Houses is a VM-202 live-pilot Tarkir wedge packet for White-centered WBG endurance, family continuity, ancestor obligation, perennation, and defensive patience.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Abzan asks what survival becomes when family, ancestry, duty, and the next generation are treated as one living obligation.
site_surface.tagline: Endure with the house. Remember through the tree. Guard the next generation.
best_for: readers drawn to family, endurance, duty, and ancestor obligation
players who like defensive patience and long-game resilience as support texture
reviewers checking that Abzan stays separate from generic WBG, Dromoka's brood, Commander products, Sultai, Mardu, Jeskai, and Temur false positives
content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Abzan material can involve family obligation, disownment, duty beyond death, political burden, and suppression of ancestor practice. This packet keeps thin biography, card, and campaign details deferred.

core_identity.summary: Abzan Houses is the White-centered WBG Tarkir wedge expression whose source-bound floor is endurance, survival, family, house continuity, ancestor obligation, perennation, active defense, and defensive patience.
core_identity.philosophy: White centers duty, family standing, house membership, and continuity. Black carries death-aware obligation, ancestor pressure, inheritance, and political survival. Green roots memory in Kin-Trees, growth after survival, earth practice, and life/death continuity.
core_identity.central_tension: Vox Mana synthesis models Abzan's tension as family continuity becoming exclusion, rigidity, political burden, or duty that outlives consent.
core_identity.interpretive_note: Central-tension and metaphysical compression are Vox Mana synthesis from ABZAN-EVID-030 and VM-198/VM-199 shaping docs. They are not official Wizards or MTG canon.

great_tension.summary: Vox Mana synthesis models Abzan's great tension as continuity with a cost: the house protects memory and future generations, but family duty can harden into exclusion, rigidity, political burden, or obligation without consent.
great_tension.placement_relevance: VM-202 live-pilot note only. Use only with normalized Abzan evidence boundaries and without converting support-only Commander, seed, architecture, or manual-fill material into claims.
